observations: Two photos show a white sewing machine (top-loading/portable style) on a table or stand.
Brand text 'TOYOTA' is visible on the machine body (photo 0 and photo 1).
A blue label area with printed markings is visible near the front (photo 0 and photo 1), but the exact model number is not readable.
The machine appears to be a tabletop unit (no full cabinet base shown).
No clear view of accessories (needles, bobbins, foot pedal, power cord) in the photos.
No clear close-up of the underside, belt, or any serial/model plate.

claims.claim: Preloved sewing table top machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photos show a tabletop sewing machine and it appears used/preloved (wear/dust visible), though exact condition level is not fully provable from images alone.
Negotiability is not shown in photos; it is only the seller's statement.

risks.risk: Machine may not be working properly (motor, timing, feed, or stitch formation). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine stitching continuously on fabric (showing needle movement and even stitches) plus a close-up of the stitch length/width settings while sewing.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not working / needs service until a stitching test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing or non-matching accessories (foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, needles, presser feet).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out on the floor/table: power cord, foot pedal, bobbins, needles, and any extra presser feet; plus a close-up of the pedal/cord connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as incomplete (no accessories) until the included parts are confirmed.

risks.risk: Model number not readable; wrong model affects parts availability and comparable pricing.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial plate (usually on the side/back/bottom) with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the lowest comparable Toyota tabletop sewing machine tier without a confirmed model.

risks.risk: Mechanical wear or damage (needle bar issues, bent needle, worn feed dogs, cracked casing) not clearly visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle area, feed dogs, bobbin case area, and underside/belt area (if accessible) in good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as having possible wear (no guarantee of smooth operation) until inspected.

proof_requests: Video stitching test on fabric (continuous sewing) showing the needle and stitch result.
Photos of included accessories: foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, needles, and presser feet (everything laid out).
Clear close-up of the model/serial plate with readable text (side/back/bottom).
Close-up photos of needle area and feed dogs, plus underside/belt area if possible.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a TOYOTA tabletop sewing machine, but the exact model and working condition (stitching test) are not verifiable remotely. Without proof of operation and included parts, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
